fato_historico: 1979: In Afghanistan, Maoists undertake the Bala Hissar uprising against the Leninist government.
energia_do_dia: Today may invite a deep reflection on the fortress you build around your heart. Much like ancient fortresses that once stood against shifting political tides in history, you may find that your emotional walls are better served by open windows. Consider how vulnerability can be a strength, inviting new light and gentle connections into your sanctuary today.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the gentle courage of an open and hopeful heart.
significado_numero: Represents the master builder of dreams and long-lasting emotional foundations.
conselho: Trust your intuition and let go of any unnecessary emotional baggage today.
